items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: And in the band I remember well, there was Peter On the Leader... And in the rhythm section were Alla Greta on piano... and me on banjo.

ctx.x: I don't remember them using any bands, you know, it might have been Sidney Fluge, or, no, I don't remember the bands that played that. Well, that's the band that, um, when Peter had the idea of this band, this original band, they used to play, he used to take dates, and, uh, he'd hire this band because at that time there was...

that old band, Pulon band was about, I believe about six pieces or so, and ten, eight and ten piece band were coming, becoming popular then. And then there was the younger musicians, you know, so I remember I was working with Sidney Desby and he had let me go for Randy Hall.

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Peter on asked me about it... I said, that's a good job... Peter Bogart was lead... I really missed Peter on that particular year

ctx.x: Oh, that was in, let's see, about around 33. 33, yeah. So I remember Captain Boyne came over and talked to Peter on and told him he wanted to come down to the office and see him. You know, he said he'd like to have his band and he'd like to have him on the boat. And he spoke to me and he said, yeah, I said, that's sales. He said, sales have worked for us, which I had already worked with Pete Marvillin and sitting in there's being banned on the boat. So Peter on asked me about it. I told him, I said, well, that's…
